status: EXPLICIT NEGATIVE CONTROLS — prevent accidental cross-game title similarity replacement
rules: Proven separate C64 game families must not be consolidated on title similarity, even if their text scores highly.
Both original packaged PRGs and approved CRTs remain unchanged; this is no media identity or binary compatibility test.
No new PRG retirement, game-page alias or autoplay reroute is authorised by these findings.

distinctTitleFamilyPairs.researchNote: Armageddon is a 1983 title with distinct C64 releases credited to Ocean and Visions; The Armageddon Man is a separate 1987 Martech geopolitical strategy game. A lexical prefix is not shared game identity.

Blagger (1983, Alligata) and the name Blagger Junior (also attached to 1985 TC Mine in Lemon64) do not identify the same game. The actual hosted Junior edition is still unverified; do not fold it into the original Blagger CRT.
